status_meaning: This is a QUALITY type-contract proposal for C1, not an implementation brief and not an approved registry. Every fork below is OWNER_PENDING and blocks only the C1 transition, not the independent read-only work.

carries: S1 PCI SSC SAD + 3-or-4 digits + no crypto no-storage

not_repeated_here: No PCI/Stripe/YooKassa/EMVCo research was re-run; the primary sources above are cited, not re-fetched.

owner_decisions_already_settled_do_not_r.text: «В любой ответ той же операции» — the previous recommendation to restrict reversibility to the payment argument only was NOT chosen.
CVC is not excluded from the current sprint; recognise and restore as for other PII.
«Да, исследовать всё семейство временных секретов» — research/type-scope expansion, not permission to treat any three digits as CVC.
storage/TTL/admin/API/HITL implementation is deferred to the next feature-sprint; the temporary reversible path is a FUTURE design intent, not a current obligation.
test-scope recognition/restoration is not permission for production retention of real CVV/CVC.
business orders, legal-entity requisites and look-alike numbers are not turned into personal documents by length alone.
known identity ambiguity/collision -> explicit refusal of the whole affected call/response; no partial payload as success.
substitute fully inherits the source form (except the value); explicit agent form beats schema-required form.
inherit the source's validity; a malformed source is not repaired by the substitute.
one ambiguous form does not by itself create a NAME; the analogue for secrets is: a bare short digit run is not a secret.

registry_disposition.fact: The v6 type registry snapshot (research/hop-format-audit/next-sprint-review/v6-snapshot/tz-agentpii6.md) enumerates 63 type codes and contains NO card-verification-code, OTP, 3DS, SMS-code, PIN or authentication-code type. The only near match is CREDIT_SUBJECT_CODE, which is a borrower credit code, not an authentication secret.
registry_disposition.consequence: The temporary-secret family is ADDITIONAL to the v6 registry and needs its own registry/allocation decision (O-SECRET-1). It must not be smuggled in as a v6 alias.
registry_disposition.verified_by: work/C0/checks.log C4 (regex extraction of the registry table, exit 0)

shared_axes.note: Every family below is declared on the same axes; a missing axis is a named gap, not an omission.
axes: syntax (charset, leading zero, separators inside the value)
malformed under a proven field (mask-not-drop vs pass)
identity binding (what the value is bound to)
fake constraints (shape of the substitute, validity inheritance, tiny-domain collision)
restore value + form (value restored; form inherited from the agent's own writing on OUT)
parts (these classes are atomic; a declared 'no parts' is itself a contract)
hops (which of IN/user, IN/tool, IN/document, IN/memory, OUT/tool_arg, OUT/answer, OUT/summary, OUT/template are asserted)
positive + hard-negative pairs (same glyphs, different context)

families.in_scope_basis: REMAINING-DECISIONS Блок 3: CVC is not excluded from this sprint; quality recognition/restoration on a synthetic isolated path.

aliases.alias_family_source: PRIMARY-SOURCES.md S1 (CAV2/CVC2/CVV2/CID 'depending on the payment brand')

scope.value_class: the 3- or 4-digit number printed on the card
scope.legal_framing: OPEN (O-SECRET-6): 152-ФЗ vs payment-standard retention rule — the two framings imply different product claims

context_evidence.primary: authoritative field name in a typed KV / schema field (cvc, cvv2, cid, ...)
context_evidence.secondary: bounded card-code cue phrase in prose within the existing cue window (<=20 non-digit characters, assets.py:432)
forbidden: bare digit run of any length
card PAN proximity (upstream population gives 0/77 adjacency — FINDINGS.md §3)
entropy / look-alike scoring (credentials.py:1-20 rejects entropy as the discriminator)
context_evidence.owner_pending: O-SECRET-2: is field-name-only sufficient, or is field-name OR bounded-cue the accepted recall boundary? 29/77 upstream annotations carry neither.

length.rule: the length set is declared per alias, never written as one fixed \d{n} and never as an unbounded \d{3,4} that widens the 3-digit false-positive surface
length.fact: a fixed \d{3} cannot match a 4-digit CID: POS-CVC-003 (cid '0000') is protected 0 times on the pinned build, and the prior mechanism probe C records amex_cid_4 as no-match

syntax.decorations_outside_the_value: inherited from the source on IN and from the agent's own writing on OUT (P02)

malformed_under_proven_field.proposed: mask-not-drop: demote to OPAQUE exactly as structured.py:371-372 already does for the numeric key types; a value written in a field the customer declares sensitive is never passed in the clear
malformed_under_proven_field.requires: CARD_VERIFICATION_CODE must be added to the numeric-key type set for the precedent to apply — that set is pseudex/structured.py:55
malformed_under_proven_field.owner_pending: O-SECRET-5 (carries Q-A4 forward): confirm mask-not-drop, accepting that the tool cannot receive a real value it could not read

identity_binding.unit: the value is bound to the field/object it was written in and to the operation
identity_binding.per_object_pairing: required proposal: a code belongs to the card object it was written in; two cards in one payload may not exchange codes (structured._by_object is the existing primitive)
identity_binding.owner_pending: O-SECRET-7 (carries Q-A5): is per-object pairing a required acceptance property?

fake_constraints.shape: exactly the source length (3 -> 3 digits, 4 -> 4 digits); never a different-length substitute
fake_constraints.validity_inheritance: P04: no checksum exists for this class; the source's digit form is inherited exactly, including a leading zero
must_not: fall through to REDACTED<6 hex> inside a numeric field (proved: RED-8)
be replaced by a CARD-shaped number (proved: RED-9)

collision_tiny_space.fact: the credentials renderer's safety argument ('collision not possible in practice: well over a hundred bits', vault.py:1765-1782) does NOT transfer here
collision_tiny_space.rule_proposed: value-only pairing is FORBIDDEN for this class; the mapping must be keyed by (field/object identity, operation) as well as value, and a substitute must avoid every real value already seen in the same binding unit (the _unique_token analogue)
collision_tiny_space.forward_collision: P07: a new real equal to an old fake is not automatically that fake; with a 1000-value domain this is LIKELY, so the refusal rule must be explicit

restore.value: the exact source digits, restored into the reply of the same operation (REMAINING-DECISIONS Блок 3 CVC destinations)
restore.form: IN inherits the source form; OUT keeps the agent's explicitly written form (P02/P03)
restore.parts: ATOMIC — no sub-parts; a partial restore is not a success (P08)
restore.residual: an unresolved substitute is reported as residual, never emitted as a fake (the /unmask_arguments contract)

hops.owner_pending: O-SECRET-9: 'any answer of the same operation' is the owner's phrase; the accepted hop set for the C1 acceptance matrix must be confirmed, because IN/document and IN/memory have no payment operation to bind to

families.storage: DEFERRED by owner: no durable retention of real values; the quality path validates recognition/restoration only. Any non-persistent mapping is a FUTURE design intent, not a current obligation.

families.in_scope_basis: REMAINING-DECISIONS Блок 3: «Да, исследовать всё семейство временных секретов».

scope.value_class: a dynamic, single-use, issuer-generated authentication value
scope.separation_from_CVC: REQUIRED: a different channel from the printed code even when both are short digit runs (PRIMARY-SOURCES.md S3/S4). They must never share one storage policy (CONTEXT-MATRIX M10).
scope.not_established: whether a 3DS one-time value is itself SAD under PCI DSS (U-b) — no rule may depend on that answer until it is verified

context_evidence.secondary: explicit one-time / channel wording ('код подтверждения', 'код из смс', 'одноразовый код', '3-D Secure')
forbidden: a field that merely contains 'sms' without naming a code (NEG-OTP-3)

length.reason: CONTEXT-MATRIX known_coverage_gaps: 'The 3DS OTP length was NOT established and is deliberately left unasserted.'
length.consequence: the contract must NOT pin a length; any implementation needs a declared bounded set plus a re-measured negative suite

identity_binding.unit: the operation/authentication event the code belongs to, not the card

fake_constraints.shape: same declared digit class as the source
fake_constraints.validity_inheritance: no checksum; inherit the digit form
fake_constraints.collision_tiny_space: same tiny-domain argument as CARD_VERIFICATION_CODE for a short length; forbidden to bind by value alone
fake_constraints.must_not: be rendered as a CARD-shaped number or as a REDACTED marker inside a numeric field

restore.value: the exact source digits in any answer of the same operation

families.storage: DEFERRED. A live authentication secret is at least as hazardous to persist as SAD; no retention is proposed.

excluded_classes.reason: a persistent static card secret, not a temporary secret; the owner's research scope is временные секреты. Its handling is a separate question (O-SECRET-4) because 'pin' is a plausible cue-confusion neighbour of 'cvv'.
already the existing CARD class with a checksum path (ru_pii.validate_luhn); only referenced as a structural neighbour.
not SAD and not a secret; exposing it identifies no one by itself and it is needed by ordinary tool calls.
already NAME; the existing mis-typing of cardholder_name as CARD is RED-9's counterexample, not a new class.
already SECRET via the leased key map (password/passwd/пароль -> SECRET, assets_source.py:1334) and a published-prefix/typical-form path; not temporary.
already SECRET at priority 8, anchored to published prefixes (credentials.py:45); deliberately NOT an entropy detector.
P05 and OWNER-DECISIONS Q3: a bare look-alike number is not made a personal document by length. Any rule that starts matching bare runs is a RED by construction.
P05: order numbers, product codes, legal-entity requisites stay open; they are the hard-negative population.
IBAN/IMEI/ICCID/... are the v6 registry's own business; this contract neither duplicates nor aliases them.

interaction_with_existing_types.SECRET_priority_8: SECRET already occupies the top priority slot (assets_source.py:1485-1503) for published-prefix credentials. A temporary-secret class must NOT be typed SECRET: the customer question differs, the renderer differs, and SECRET's collision argument (long CSPRNG bodies) does not transfer to a 1000-value domain.
interaction_with_existing_types.existing_keyed_SECRET_path: the leased key map already types password/passwd/secret/секрет/пароль as SECRET (assets_source.py:1334) and keyed values are protected today (probe CTRL-1 held: {"password": "hunter2"} -> SECRET). The typed-KV mechanism is therefore LIVE; the temporary-secret classes are simply absent from the leased map.
interaction_with_existing_types.OPAQUE_demotion_precedent: structured.py:371-372 demotes a numeric key type whose value has no digit to OPAQUE instead of dropping it; a card-code field that reads a malformed value should follow the same precedent (O-SECRET-5).
interaction_with_existing_types.no_renderer_fallback: vault.py:1929 renders an unrenderer'd type as REDACTED<6 hex>; proved by RED-8 for a hypothetical CVC type. A new class without its own renderer is inadmissible.

acceptance_properties_for_C1.property: fielded and cued positives are protected; every same-glyph business negative stays open, in the SAME run
the declared length set per alias is matched; no fixed-length regex leaves a declared variant open
a card code and an issuer OTP in one utterance receive DIFFERENT classes and different policies
the substitute has exactly the source length and digit shape; never a REDACTED marker and never a CARD-shaped number
restoration returns the exact digits of the same operation; a form the agent wrote itself is preserved; a partial restore is a failure, not a success
per-object binding: two cards in one payload never exchange codes; an indistinguishable pair fails closed
tiny-domain collision: a new real equal to an old fake is not silently restored as that fake; the refusal is explicit
no real secret value appears in any artifact of the acceptance run (fixtures synthetic only; absence proven by reading the stores, not by trusting the API)
the quality path is isolated: no durable retention of real values is required by, or implied by, a green C1 quality result
